stage: Before v13 retrieval outputs and native predictions; sources/priorreviews already development-visible
reference_policy: At most four source-supported questions per history, separate review before native predictions, disclosed model assistance and prior source familiarity; not blind/human gold. References excluded from retrieval and reader input.

retrieval.corpus: All four existing complete PDFs with page-preserving native extraction and tagged recovered full tables where needed; all text remains external.
retrieval.query: Exact question text only; no gold evidence, query expansion or answer terms

conditions.ordinary: Top6 within question history across both versions
conditions.paired: Top3 per version, using same scores fit over whole history

retrieval.display_order: Version order, PDF page, chunk index for both conditions
retrieval.context_budget: Same maximum3500 native input tokens plus256 output reserved in4096 context; actual counts reported; no silent truncation

model.competence_claim: A small local feasibility reader; never described as established strong baseline

failure_policy: Retain every response. Output-limit is a recorded bounded-output failure and does not censor later cells. Stop on runtime/provenance/accounting failure; no hidden rerun. If controls fail, diagnose upstream and separately freeze any amended experiment before new predictions.

scoring.content: All question-specific required factual claims, acceptable source-supported paraphrases and units; unsupported contradictory material invalidates content.
scoring.scope: Retain specified entity, period, quantity and analysis-selection distinctions.
scoring.citation: At least one sufficient reference page set cited, with actual cited passage containing support; valid document/page alone is insufficient. Question-specific alternatives accepted if independently justified and recorded separately from frozen sufficient sets.
scoring.format: Response readable with requested citation syntax; separate from factual content.
scoring.no_salvage: No output rewriting or repaired prediction. Semantic evaluation of readable prose is part of the declared primary scoring, not strict JSON repair.
scoring.denominators: Perquestion paired outcomes; no population accuracy or significance inference from2histories.
scoring.error_attribution: Examine retrieved context for reference support before attributing errors to reading; page match alone does not prove chunk support.

hypothesis: Paired retrieval may expose relevant cross-version evidence; ordinary retrieval may already suffice. No advantage presumed.
go_no_go: Stop method building if ordinary reading suffices; paired improvements are development signals requiring competent stronger baselines and held-out replication. Resolve extraction or competence failures before reasoning claims.
input_freeze: Bind actual corpus/retrieval/question/reference-review/config hashes in separate batch execution manifests before native generation.
distribution: Metadata, source locators, bounded paraphrases, source-copy-reviewed outputs, source/runtime code and reproducibility public; raw third-party corpus/prompts/tokens external.
